title: IVG Smart Max Pro Blue Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Pro Blue IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod delivers a striking berry flavour with a refreshing edge. Sweet and tangy Raspberry combines with juicy Blueberry, rounded off by a clean icy finish that brightens the exhale. Each pack contains a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. Designed to last for up to 12,000 puffs depending on usage, this smart refill system removes the need for coil changes or manual refilling. Fitted with mesh coil technology, the pod ensures consistent vapour production and well-defined flavour from beginning to end. Made exclusively for the IVG Smart Max 12K Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, installation is quick and simple — just click the pod into place and you’re ready to vape. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
